description: This file defines the LogoutController class for handling user logout operations in the OrangeHRM authentication module. It extends an abstract controller and uses services to invalidate the user session and redirect to the login page.

classes.name: LogoutController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling user logout by invalidating session and redirecting to login.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Performs the logout logic: invalidates the session and redirects to login page.
